description: Defines the QuicClientPromisedInfo class which manages the client-side state of server push streams in QUIC, including handling promise headers, response headers, and rendezvous with client requests.

classes.name: quic::QuicClientPromisedInfo
classes.description: Manages the client-side state of a server push stream, including promise validation, response handling, and rendezvous with client requests.

methods.name: QuicClientPromisedInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the promised info with session, stream ID, and URL.

methods.name: OnPromiseHeaders
methods.description: Validates promise headers received from the server.

methods.name: OnResponseHeaders
methods.description: Stores response headers and proceeds with validation.

methods.name: HandleClientRequest
methods.description: Handles a client request matching the promise, performing rendezvous.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the promised info with an error code.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Returns the session associated with this promise.

methods.name: request_headers
methods.description: Returns the request headers associated with the promise.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the promise.

methods.name: is_validating
methods.description: Checks if a client request is pending for this promise.

methods.name: FinalValidation
methods.description: Performs final validation of the promise.
